# Readside BetLab

> A daily football-market scanner that grades upcoming fixtures as Opportunity, Trap, or Ignore using Value, Context, Explosion, and Trap scores.

Readside BetLab pulls live odds and independent probability models to surface where the market may be mispriced. Every match card explains the reasoning in plain language: recommended market and selection, best available odds, stake sizing, and a confidence read. Model-priced picks are labelled as "not yet validated" so readers can weigh evidence quality.

## Pages
- [Today's briefing](/): Live scan of today's football fixtures with Opportunity, Trap and Ignore verdicts.
- [All matches](/matches): Full list of scanned fixtures within the 72-hour window.
- [Match detail](/match/$matchId): Per-match breakdown — the answer, price check, stake, confidence, and score bars.
